section.title: Remote file from GitHub
section.p: A GitHub page URL is rewritten to the raw file. The language comes from the .yaml extension.

section.title: Selected lines of a remote file
section.p: GitHub-style #L13-L19 fragments select lines; normalize-space removes the shared indentation.

section.title: Forcing a language
section.p: An explicit outputclass="language-…" wins over the file name. This also works for inline code with no coderef.
